"""

def is_prime(n: int) -> bool:
    """Return whether n is prime.

    The implementation handles non‑negative integers.  Negative numbers and 0/1 are
    not prime.  2 and 3 are the only even and odd primes less than 5.  For
    larger numbers we perform trial division using odd divisors up to the
    integer square root.  This is efficient enough for the typical input size
    used in the test suite.
    """
    # Reject non‑positive values
    if n < 2:
        return False
    # 2 and 3 are primes
    if n in (2, 3):
        return True
    # Even numbers greater than 2 are composite
    if n % 2 == 0:
        return False
    # Trial division using odd numbers only
    import math
    limit = math.isqrt(n)
    i = 3
    while i <= limit:
        if n % i == 0:
            return False
        i += 2
    return True
